events.event_name: New York Transit Museum Bus Festival
events.brand: New York Transit Museum × MTA New York City Transit
events.address: Emily Warren Roebling Plaza, 1 Water St, Brooklyn, NY 11201
events.what_it_is: Annual waterfront festival featuring historic NYC buses, hands-on activities, transit staff, trivia and a scavenger hunt.
events.what_is_free: Festival admission, access to the historic bus displays and advertised public activities are free.
events.caveats: Official Brooklyn Bridge Park listing says advance registration is encouraged but not required. The event runs rain or shine; buses and equipment displayed are subject to change.
events.practical_notes: Saturday Sept. 19, 10 AM–3:30 PM at Emily Warren Roebling Plaza in Brooklyn Bridge Park. Free public event; advance registration is optional rather than an admission requirement.

events.address: Hoyt Street at Atlantic Avenue, Brooklyn, NY 11201
events.what_it_is: Back-to-school Open Streets literacy afternoon with crafts, coloring, word games, a free-book giveaway and a kids textile/t-shirt activity.
events.what_is_free: General event admission and the advertised free-book giveaway are free. The event is open to the public.
events.caveats: General attendance requires no registration. A specific instructor-led kids t-shirt workshop has limited space and may use separate registration; walk-ins for that workshop are accepted only if space allows.
events.practical_notes: Saturday Sept. 19, 1–4 PM on the Hoyt Open Street at Atlantic Avenue. General event is free and walk-in; do not imply the limited-capacity t-shirt workshop is guaranteed.

events.brand: Peanuts × Charles M. Schulz Museum and Research Center
events.address: 25 Little West 12th Street, New York, NY 10014
events.what_it_is: A 16,000-square-foot Peanuts exhibition with ten immersive zones, designer-created Snoopy and Woodstock looks, archival material, music and sports displays, plus a retail shop.
events.what_is_free: Admission to the exhibition is free; merchandise in the gift shop is for purchase.
events.caveats: Official Peanuts page says hours may vary for special events. Last entry is 5:30 PM. The exhibition is free, but the on-site shop is not.
events.practical_notes: Open daily Sept. 2–26, 10 AM–6 PM, at 25 Little West 12th Street. Last entry 5:30 PM; check the official page for any special-event hour changes.
